title: Portfolio mobile feedback polish for hero, covers, profile, footer, and commercial copy
locator: cd jossue-portfolio && npm run validate; Playwright screenshots test-results/mobile-feedback-hero.png, test-results/mobile-feedback-covers.png, test-results/mobile-feedback-commercial-copy.png, test-results/mobile-feedback-profile-fixed-2.png, test-results/mobile-feedback-footer-fixed.png; npx astro dev --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4321 --background; curl -I http://192.168.100.110:4321/es/
result: PASS: home hero titles and subtitles were shortened, content was vertically centered, and each SVG slide gained additional lightweight CSS/SVG animation elements. Hero controls now fit within the 573px mobile viewport with three centered thumbnails. Project card covers removed the floating square accent and added lightweight brand-cover animations for gradient, identity, and meter bars. The home profile section now renders as two non-overlapping columns at the reviewed mobile width, with photo plus text. Footer now uses a black background with light text. The diagnostic section copy was rewritten to be more commercial. npm run validate passed: Astro check 0 diagnostics, ESLint passed, build generated 29 pages, route test passed for 29 routes plus robots/sitemap, link test passed for 495 local links, Playwright passed 168/168. LAN server restarted and http://192.168.100.110:4321/es/ returned 200 OK.
limitations: PUBLIC_SITE_URL was unset, so Astro used portfolio.invalid fallback in validation. Motion was validated through CSS and screenshots; phone touch review still requires the phone and Mac on the same LAN.
